newsitem.title: USA: Ontrack to unveil data service for lawyers.
newsitem.headline: Ontrack to unveil data service for lawyers.

text.p: Ontrack Data International Inc. on Friday unveiled a service, geared toward lawyers and criminal investigators, that recovers information deliberately erased from computers.

The new service, called Computer Evidence Services, gives lawyers a weapon in investigating trade secret theft, harassment by e-mail, and malicious destruction of data by disgruntled employees, Ontrack exectuives said.
"We get hundreds of calls a month" from lawyers, said Rick Moher, an Ontrack account executive. "We probably complete hundreds of new jobs each quarter."

Ontrack, based in Eden Prairie, Minn., recovers lost computer information for big companies. Until now, the company has specialized in recovering data from malfunctioning computers. Now the company is using its expertise to help lawyers in investigations.

Moher said the 10-year-old company began getting a "trickle" of calls from lawyers asking for help two years ago. Now, about 10 percent of the company's business comes from lawyers and crime investigators, he said.
In 1996, the company had $26.8 million in revenue.
